label: Contested / two models disagree

unsupported_claims: Tile classifier: late blight across 68% of the field.
Whole-image check: no disease (0% of visible tissue, 95% confident).
verification.block_reason: Two independent checks disagree about this field. The tile classifier reports late blight across 68% of the scanned area; a whole-image check of the same photograph reports no disease. Treatment advice was withheld rather than issued on the strength of one of them. The second check reported: "A wide field of young green potato plants growing in rows of reddish-brown soil under a blue sky, no lesions visible."

report.en: Two checks were run on this photograph and they did not agree. Our tile-by-tile scanner found signs of late blight across 68.4% of the potato field; a second check that looks at the whole photograph found no disease. Because of that disagreement we are not giving you a treatment recommendation. Walk the field and look at the plants yourself, and show this scan to your local agriculture extension officer before you spray anything.
report.hi: इस तस्वीर की दो अलग-अलग जाँच की गईं और दोनों के नतीजे अलग निकले। हमारे टाइल स्कैनर को आलू के खेत के 68.4% भाग में late blight (पछेती झुलसा) के लक्षण मिले, जबकि पूरी तस्वीर देखने वाली दूसरी जाँच में कोई बीमारी नहीं मिली। इस मतभेद के कारण हम कोई दवा नहीं बता रहे हैं। कृपया खुद खेत में जाकर पौधे देखें, और छिड़काव से पहले अपने नज़दीकी कृषि विस्तार अधिकारी को यह रिपोर्ट दिखाएँ।
